description: Pricing fixes after production review: (1) /pricing 'How Credits Work' paragraph 3 still described the retired subscription prices ($24.50/200, $35/300, $63/600) — rewritten to the one-time package numbers with clear per-term pricing; (2) six/twelve-month strike prices now carry the /mo unit so the struck-through monthly price cannot be misread as a one-time price; (3) the homepage pricing block switches from the legacy subscription product cards to the same one-time packages (pricingPackages written to the '/' row; renderer falls back to product cards when absent). Costs table, h1, canonical, packs, discounts, FAQ and JSON-LD stay as applied earlier today.

credits: One product photo uses 24 credits. A 6-second video uses 24, a 10-second video uses 40, a 15-second video uses 60, and a 30-second video uses 120. You can add up to 7 reference photos. The amount appears before you confirm the job.
A job reserves its credits while it runs and charges them when the file is ready. When a job fails, the reserved credits return to your balance on their own. You do not send a ticket for that return.

Every package is a one-time purchase, and its credits arrive at the start of each month of the term. Starter is $24 for one month with 200 credits — about 8 product photos or 3 fifteen-second videos. Pro is $59 with 500 credits, about 20 photos or 8 of those videos. Studio is $129 with 1,200 credits, about 50 photos or 20. Six- and twelve-month terms cost less per month, and one-time credit packs from $14 cover a month that runs short.
